steps.label: a focus event on the scroll whose content fits reaches the listener lifted onto it
focus on the scroll runs the ui.focus reducer lifted onto it
a key on it runs the onKeyDown written on it
leaving it runs the ui.blur reducer lifted onto it
focus on the input inside the other scroll runs ui.focus(List) once
a key in that input runs ui.key(List) once
